where: The Bell Cellar (the flooded cellars and the drowned belfry pit under Lowtinder's lamp-house, where the old town bell lies in black water; a rope climbs the old shaft to Tinderwick's well)
mood: A flooded stone cellar under the sea: dripping water, black still pools, and somewhere a huge old bell humming when the tide turns. Hushed, patient and a little sad, never horror.
_motif_note: Low strength, the cave treatment (old-seams' precedent): the first notes of the lullaby, tolled slowly like a bell under water.
_stall_note: deliberately sparse cave: the silences between the tolls are part of the cue (dead_air.py allows up to max_stall)
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
a deep bronze bell tolling a slow four-note phrase
sparse high triangle plinks like water dripping into still pools
a soft pulse-wave echo answering from far away
flooded stone cellar in the dark, ancient and quiet

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a lone drip echoes in the dark, then the low drone breathes in beneath it}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the bell tolls a slow four-note phrase, one note every two beats, over the low drone; drips fall in the silences}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the toll again, now answered by a soft far-off pulse-wave echo of the phrase, the drone a little warmer}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the drone sinks lower, a slow rising figure climbs as if up a long shaft toward faint light, then settles}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the bell's four-note toll returns over the drone and drips; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
